text: For the Microsoft Software Engineer Apprentice role, the OA usually has around 2 coding questions in 60–90 minutes, but the exact pattern may vary. The questions generally focus on arrays, strings, hashing, sliding window, two pointers, and basic trees or graphs. The difficulty is usually Easy–Medium to Medium, though one question can be tricky. Focus on DSA basics, optimized solutions, and edge cases.
